findings.summary: Linear scan membership check inside a list comprehension causes O(N * M) time complexity if allowed is a list or sequence.
findings.suggested_action: If elements within allowed are hashable, convert allowed to a set before iterating. If unhashable types such as nested lists must be supported, document the quadratic complexity or consider alternative indexing strategies if performance becomes a bottleneck.
